name: Akinashi Haru
source:
He is a modest and unconfident office worker who struggles with socializing. He is not very smart, often being scolded by his boss.
Since he joined the company two months earlier than [url=/c139408]Shion Tatsunami[/url], he was asked to act as Tatsunami's senior. 
Tatsunami, who was a close friend in private, was an excellent individual who consistently acchieved results. However, he felt inferior and jealous, leading him to distance himself from Tatsunami.
